ask: Ask our X followers which feature we should build next: dark mode, exports or an iPad app.

steps.why: The decision: the poll field on save-post, in the saving call. Bolta refuses a poll X would reject (2 to 4 options of 25 characters at most), with the reason. The question is the post's text. It runs one day, the default, which suits a quick product pulse; a longer one is an X setting (post_type POLL with poll_duration_minutes).

say: Saved to Acme as an X draft: a one-day poll with Dark mode, Exports and iPad app. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: A poll on a post with several parts: Bolta refuses it.
